description: Kibana events, with the change against the previous period of the same length. Generated from PREV_TILES in scripts/lib/panels.mjs: do not edit.

url.query: FROM logs-cloud-audit-events-view | WHERE event_time >= NOW() - 15 days | STATS t0 = MIN(event_time) | EVAL t0 = TO_LONG(t0)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-cloud-audit-events-view | WHERE event_time <= TO_DATETIME(?_tend) AND event_time > TO_DATETIME(2 * TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tstart)) - TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tend))) AND (event_time > TO_DATETIME(?_tstart) OR event_time >= NOW() - 15 days) AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Unnamed API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE service.name == "serverless-kibana" | STATS cur = COUNT(*) WHERE event_time > TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), prev = COUNT(*) WHERE event_time <= TO_DATETIME(?_tstart) | EVAL s = TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tstart)), e = TO_LONG(TO_DATETIME(?_tend))

transform.expr: isValid(t0) && datum.s - datum.len * 1000 >= max(t0, now() - lookbackMs)

!datum.full ? 'no full prior ' + datum.span : datum.prev === 0 ? (datum.cur === 0 ? '0 in prior ' + datum.span + ' too' : 'none in prior ' + datum.span) : datum.cur >= 10 * datum.prev ? round(datum.cur / datum.prev) + '× vs prior ' + datum.span : datum.cur === datum.prev ? 'same as prior ' + datum.span : (abs(datum.pct) < 1 ? '<1' : abs(datum.pct)) + '% vs prior ' + datum.span
